hash_rule: semantic_body_sha256 is SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON for this object with semantic_body_sha256 and hash_rule omitted, ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, separators=(',', ':')

pool_rule.baseline: exact node selected by production select_admissible_action under frozen runtime config/snapshot
pool_rule.eligible: candidate is in frozen current valid frontier AND effective_selection_allowed=true AND experiment_allowed=true AND action kind in safe_action_kinds
pool_rule.construction: if baseline is eligible, take baseline plus up to four highest-ranked other eligible nodes in exact frozen production ranked order; canonical pool order for probabilities is baseline first then selected alternatives in ranked order
pool_rule.skip: if baseline is not eligible or resulting pool size < 2, execute baseline deterministically with propensity 1.0

probability_rule.target_policy_support: v0 learned policy may assign non-baseline mass only to current randomized-pool members; otherwise deterministic baseline fallback is part of target/deployed policy

random_draw.u64: unsigned big-endian integer of first 8 SHA-256 digest bytes
random_draw.selection: first cumulative-probability interval in canonical pool order containing uniform; last pool member absorbs floating-point rounding residue
random_draw.log: message components, exact ordered pool, exact probability vector, u64, uniform, chosen node, chosen propensity

support_reporting.zero_support_rule: no OPE claim for target mass outside behavior support; v0 deploy/evaluation policy falls back to exact deterministic baseline there

change_control: Any change to epsilon, safe_action_kinds, pool construction, seed, draw algorithm, probability formula, support floor, or fallback semantics creates a new protocol_id/version and requires re-baselining.
